alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued June 19 at 9:01AM CDT by NWS Shreveport LA
alerts.description:
At 901 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking an area of strong
thunderstorms extending from 10 miles northwest of Bagwell to 6 miles
southeast of Wilkerson, or extending from 17 miles northwest of
Clarksville to 11 miles south of Boxelder, moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Texarkana, Mount Pleasant, Atlanta, Wake Village, Ashdown, New
Boston, Pittsburg, Clarksville, Horatio, Foreman, Boxelder,
Hagansport, Idabel, Broken Bow, Nash, Hooks, Mount Vernon,
Daingerfield and De Kalb.

alerts.description:

* WHERE...Portions of southwest Oklahoma, including the following
counties, Comanche, Cotton and Tillman and northern Texas,
including the following counties, Clay and Wichita.

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen.

the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Burkburnett, Frederick, Walters, Geronimo, Grandfield,
Temple, Chattanooga, Randlett, Manitou, Devol, Faxon,
Hollister, Loveland, Cookietown, Cashion, Taylor and Charlie.
